== Description ==

Players at a Friday Cube Draft table during the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025: [[Robbie Hendon]] (foreground left, grey T-shirt and grey SWCCG cap), [[Mike Turner]] (left middle, tan cap with sunglasses, black hoodie), [[Matt Thornton]] (back left, brown cap with yellow patch, beard, ''Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge'' T-shirt), [[Steve Harpster]] (back center, white hair, glasses, grey T-shirt), [[Apollo Chu]] (right, blue ''SpongeBob'' T-shirt, curly hair), and [[Justin Miyashiro]] (foreground right, black graphic T-shirt, glasses).
